verdict_rule: hyp_cells.verdict: design fold fixes the sign; confirm fold decides. CONDITIONAL_POSITIVE = confirm mean > 0, t >= 2, design mean > 0; FAILED_VARIANT = confirm mean <= 0, or t < 2 with MDE <= effect worth having; else CANNOT_DISTINGUISH. SE over date blocks, MDE = 2.8 SE.

cells.title: 10Y yield spike lifts mortgage REITs via steepening
cells.refutation: If the mREIT basket's beta-adjusted return is not positive over t+1 to t+5 after yield spikes, the steepening benefit is refuted.
cells.separation_from_beta: Agency mREIT basket outperforms rate-sensitive utilities and REITs beta-adjusted, isolating curve steepening.

cells.title: Oil shock lifts tanker equities via freight rate expectations
cells.refutation: If tanker basket's beta-adjusted return is not positive over t+1 to t+5 after oil shocks, the freight-rate read-through fails.
cells.separation_from_beta: Tanker basket outperforms its market beta and the energy sector on t+1 to t+5, while other transports do not.

cells.title: Clinical trial success lifts correlation peers next session
cells.refutation: If high-correlation peers show no significant next-session abnormal return relative to vol-matched unlinked peers, the hypothesis is refuted.
cells.separation_from_beta: Compare peers' next-session return to their own market-beta-adjusted return and to vol-matched non-linked peers; effect should be present only for high-correlation peers.
